setup: Fresh >=5 or >=6 upper-BB breaches at exact 15m OPEN; freeze breached upper-band prices.
entry: Place conceptual SHORT limit above setup OPEN; valid for next 4x15m bars. First touch fills at exact limit price.
target_definition: Frozen setup-time breached BB rank; near1 is closest/highest breached BB.
target_consumption_guard: Exclude if target was touched before fill.
fast_screen: Conservative 15m: any target/stop touch in fill bar => loss; same later bar both => loss.
promotion_rule: Only if both pre-2025 and 2025+ are positive under fast screen, rerun exact 1m chronology.
